feedback:
Judged from earlier races and this candidate's contents only. No outcome is stated for it. The candidate is iteration 8's design (kp 7.0, kd 0.3, outer sensors at x = ±0.06, sensor_size 0.016, base_speed 1.4) with line_loss changed from last_direction to search_right. Every value is inside its contract range.

The main problem is that the candidate is not the best design on the evidence. Iteration 6 (kd 0.2, same geometry, kp 7.0, last_direction) scored 64.74, the best raced score. Iteration 8 (kd 0.3) scored 62.23, with oval progress 0.202 against 0.218, slalom progress 0.096 against 0.103, and s-bend progress unchanged at 0.14. Raising kd lowered oscillation (oval 0.159 to 0.156, s-bend 0.173 to 0.130) but cost progress, so kd 0.2 is the better derivative setting for score. The search_right change is still worth testing, because slalom has lost the line once per run in every race (iterations 0 to 8) and its progress is stuck near 0.10. Changing kd and line_loss together would confound the result, so kd should go back to 0.2 and search_right should be tested alone against iteration 6.

Read the next race as follows. (a) If slalom line_loss_events fall or slalom progress rises above 0.10 with oval and s-bend progress near iteration 6, keep search_right and move on. (b) If slalom progress falls, or the oval or s-bend worsen, revert line_loss to last_direction and address the slalom loss through geometry, for example the outer sensors at x = ±0.08. (c) If the robot tracks without off_track but completion_time exceeds 3 s, raise base_speed to 1.6 in a later single-group revision. Report progress, max_error, line_loss_events and steering_oscillation per track, plus completion_time and rms_error.

Keep controller.line_loss = search_right and make no other change, so it is tested alone against iteration 6. Slalom has lost the line once per run in every earlier race with progress stuck near 0.10.

Keep kp 7.0, ki 0.0, base_speed 1.4, the sensor weights and all geometry at iteration 6 values. If completion_time exceeds 3 s without off_track in a later race, raise base_speed to 1.6 as a single-group change.
